Thank you for reporting the issue regarding the app crashing on startup after the upgrade.

We have received your incident report and will begin investigating the root cause immediately. In the meantime, could you please provide more details such as:
- Your operating system and version
- Steps to reproduce the crash, if possible
- Any relevant error messages or logs displayed on crash

This information will help us troubleshoot and resolve the issue faster.

We appreciate your prompt feedback and patience while we address this issue.
